sloka: पितृव्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वा त्रिशिराश्चापमाददे।हनुमन्तं च सङ्क्रुद्धो विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७०.३३ ।।
transliteration: pitṛvyaṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā triśirāścāpamādade।hanumantaṁ ca saṅkruddho vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.70.33 ।।

translations.english: Trisira got enraged seeing his uncle killed, seized his bow and with a sharp arrow pierced Hanuman.
